_about: Few-shot exemplar bank for the 'specialized' parser level. Each exemplar is a short labeled request (2-3 per label). They were written after data/specialization_cases.json and are checked by tests to not duplicate any held-out request (cosine similarity below 0.6). Nothing is trained: the parser finds the nearest exemplars with the TF-IDF index and copies their labels when they are similar enough.
